about_the_game:
Help Iluminatus reach the top of each level and escape this strange world! Face off against mutant viruses, creepy llamas, unsettling aliens, and mighty bosses.

Get ready for a bizarre adventure where you don’t control the character directly—your only action is to jump to survive. Beat different levels, unlock the abilities you need, and advance further into the game.

This platformer features two distinct game modes:

  • Story Mode: Climb massive pyramids, hopping from platform to platform to reach the summit. Every level is a new puzzle that will challenge your wits and skills.

  • Endless Mode: How far can you make it? Run nonstop through a path packed with enemies and obstacles. Time your jumps, avoid falling, and crush your high score.

Are you ready to escape and uncover the mysteries of this bizarre world?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8, Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.0 support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
